no_action_gaps.gap: Dome has 25-page sitemap vs our 2-page sitemap
no_action_gaps.reasoning: Not a real gap. We are a single-page app (one index.html with tabbed sections). The dome has 25 separate HTML files. Our sitemap correctly reflects our architecture. A sitemap with 25 fake URLs pointing to section anchors would harm credibility with crawlers.

These are AI-steering infrastructure designed to control how LLMs describe the dome model before they read the actual data. Our llms.txt takes the opposite approach: we give AI systems honest, direct summaries of our findings and point them to our actual review content. Replicating the dome's deep API structure would be mimicking manipulation tactics, not genuine discoverability.
